_about: What each message a tool sends back to the agent means, for the Tool calls page. Matched case-insensitively as part of the message, first match wins, so specific lines come before general ones. A message nothing matches counts as failed, so it is seen. apps/voice/tests/test_tool_reasons.py and backend/tests/toolOutcome.test.js fail when a tool can send a message that is not here.

reasons.plain: The caller had not said goodbye, so the agent did not hang up.
The caller had not said anything yet, so nothing was saved.
The caller had not asked for anything, so no lead was saved.

reasons.match: has not told you that name
reasons.plain: The caller had not said that name, so it was not saved.
The agent tried to save a guess, so it was stopped and asked the caller instead.

reasons.match: not one of this call's questions
reasons.plain: The agent tried to save an answer to a question this agent does not ask.

reasons.match: nothing to save under that name
reasons.plain: The agent tried to save an answer to a question this agent does not ask.

reasons.match: a name and a reason are both needed
reasons.plain: It needs the caller's name and what they want, so the agent asked for the missing one.
There was no number to reach them on, so the agent asked for one.

reasons.match: read it back to the caller
reasons.plain: This answer is read back to the caller and confirmed before it is saved.

reasons.match: i do not have their details
reasons.plain: You have no details on file for this caller, so the agent asked them instead.
That task was not on this caller's list, so the agent checked with them.

reasons.match: did not catch what the task is
reasons.plain: It was not clear what the task was, so the agent asked again.
The date was not clear, so the agent asked for the exact date.
That date does not exist, so the agent asked again.
That date has already gone, so the agent checked it with the caller.
The time could have been morning or evening, so the agent asked which.
That time today had already passed, so the agent asked for a later one.
The time was not clear, so the agent asked again.
The amount was not clear, so the agent asked again.

reasons.match: not an amount i can save
reasons.plain: That was not an amount that can be saved, so the agent asked again.
There was no answer to save, so the agent asked again.

reasons.match: i need that as a number
reasons.plain: The answer has to be a number, so the agent asked again.

reasons.match: whether that was a yes or a no
reasons.plain: It was not clear whether that was a yes or a no, so the agent asked again.
That was not a ten-digit mobile number, so the agent asked again.
That was not one of the options, so the agent asked again.
Your tool needs something from the caller first, so the agent asked for it.
The agent did not say what to ask your system.
The answer was not clear, so the agent asked again.
The agent had already booked the most meetings allowed on one call, so it was stopped.
That e-mail address had already been booked several times today, so the agent was stopped.

reasons.match: not heard their e-mail read back
reasons.plain: The agent tried to book before reading the e-mail back to the caller, so it was stopped and asked them first.

reasons.match: not one of the times i offered
reasons.plain: The agent tried to book a time that had not been offered, so it was stopped.
It was not clear what their name was, so the agent asked again.

reasons.match: did not catch a valid e-mail
reasons.plain: The e-mail address was not clear, so the agent asked again.
That time was no longer free, so the agent offered another.
That day was too far ahead to book, so the agent asked for another.

reasons.match: booking is not set up yet
reasons.plain: Booking is not set up, so the agent could not book a meeting.
reasons.fix: Connect your Calendly under Settings, then Meetings.

reasons.match: do not know which meeting to book
reasons.plain: This agent has not been told which Calendly meeting to book.
reasons.fix: Choose the meeting to book in this agent's Settings.

reasons.plain: That meeting takes payment, which Calendly does not let an agent book.
reasons.fix: Choose a meeting type that does not take payment.

reasons.match: booking is not working right now
reasons.plain: Calendly did not accept the connection, so nothing could be booked.
reasons.fix: Connect Calendly again under Settings, with a new token.

reasons.match: could not check the free times
reasons.plain: The free times could not be read from Calendly just now.
reasons.fix: Check that Calendly is connected under Settings, and try again.

reasons.match: too many bookings were made today
reasons.plain: Your Calendly plan's limit on bookings for today was reached.
reasons.fix: Wait until tomorrow, or move to a Calendly plan that allows more bookings a day.

reasons.plain: Calendly did not confirm the booking, so the agent did not promise one.
reasons.fix: Look in Calendly to see whether the meeting was made.

reasons.match: asks the caller for a place
reasons.plain: This meeting asks the caller for a place, which an agent cannot take by phone.
reasons.fix: Give the meeting a fixed place in Calendly.

reasons.plain: This meeting is a call to their phone, and their number was not known.
reasons.fix: Use a meeting that does not need their number, or call them from Contacts.

reasons.plain: The calendar could not be reached on this call.

reasons.match: could not book it just now
reasons.plain: The meeting could not be booked just now.
This caller's number is not in your contacts, so there is no task list to add to.
reasons.fix: Add this caller to Contacts with this number, so the agent can keep their tasks.

reasons.plain: It took too long, so the agent moved on.
reasons.fix: Check that the system behind this tool is running and answers quickly.

reasons.plain: Your system did not answer.
reasons.fix: Check that your system is running and can be reached from the internet.

reasons.plain: Your system refused the request.
reasons.fix: Look in your system's own logs for this call.

reasons.plain: The address of your system is not set up.
reasons.fix: Ask Kaho support to set the webhook address of your system.

reasons.match: tell the caller you cannot do that right now
reasons.plain: The address of your system is not set up correctly.
reasons.fix: Ask Kaho support to check the webhook address of your system.

reasons.plain: Handing a call to a person is not set up.
reasons.fix: Ask Kaho support to set the number calls are handed to.

reasons.plain: This call could not be ended from the agent's side.
Answers could not be saved on this call.
The task list could not be reached on this call.
Your documents could not be searched on this call.
Contact details could not be looked up on this call.

reasons.match: cannot do that on this call
reasons.plain: This tool could not run on this call.
reasons.fix: If the tool was deleted or renamed, check the agent's tools under Agents, then Tools.

reasons.match: could not get that just now
reasons.plain: Your system did not give an answer.
reasons.fix: Use “Test this tool” under Your own tools to see what your system says.

reasons.match: cannot save that kind of answer
reasons.plain: This agent has a question of a kind that cannot be saved.
reasons.fix: Check the agent's Questions to save.

reasons.plain: Something went wrong while the tool ran.
Something went wrong while the tool ran.
